checks.detail: attempt identity, owner, lifetime, and retry schedule are not implicit
expiry enables replacement but does not make a stale receipt current
fixed inputs are deterministic under tests while the owner supplies CSPRNG bytes
restart rejects partial durable receipt metadata
zero-duration and otherwise unreachable active states fail restore
backoff has a prior-attempt provenance requirement
ready-at and expiry-at instants are inclusive and zero clock is invalid
zero, overlong, and overflowing leases are rejected before mint
malformed folder, destination, operation, generation, cutpoint, or worker cannot enter state
receipt minting fails closed at both entropy and counter boundaries
the policy does not publish an unvalidated intermediate state
tokens are scoped to one exact durable transition rather than only random bytes
a stale sender cannot install backoff over a replacement attempt
adversarial boundary tests pin the pure state machine
the pure authority layer is compiled, linked, and executed
randomness stays at the process boundary and policy stays deterministic
a sealed revision cannot omit the pure policy, runtime, audit, or design record
